details: No malicious behavior was identified in the package contents. The package name resembles popular Tailwind-related UI libraries, which can indicate name-confusion risk, but no exfiltration, dropper, silent-relay, credential distribution, or install-time remote code execution was observed in the inspected files. Routing to human review so a reviewer can assess name-confusion risk and confirm the package's stated purpose against its contents.
